run_evidence.note: F1: grant-path rejects non-OID operator_oid (InvalidOperatorOidFormatError) AND unenrolled OID-format operator (InvalidOperatorSignatureError). RED before fix; GREEN after.
F2: NODE_ENV=production hard-blocks _testClearEnrollment, _testEnrollOperatorForTest, and capbundle/1 sentinel bypass even with SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS=true.
F3: challenge_nonce removed from GET /local/pending listing; still present in POST /local/gate 201 response (client flow intact).
Migrated from operator:steve (legacy non-OID) to enrolled oid-<64hex> operators. Adds test vectors for non-OID rejection (InvalidOperatorOidFormatError) and HTTP 400 at the router edge.

description: Conformance vectors for the re-panel security findings F1 (SEVERE), F2 (MEDIUM), F3 (MEDIUM) on the /local + engine grant authorization path. All three gaps were identified in the Security and Adversary re-panel dated 2026-06-22. RED-before / GREEN-after for each. TEST KEYS ONLY.

vectors.name: f1-grant-path-rejects-non-oid-operator
vectors.failing_before: updateGrantPredicate() succeeded: attack SUCCEEDED, grant was updated by unenrolled attacker with non-OID operator_oid='operator:steve'. The regex gate `if (/^oid-[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.operator_oid))` let any non-OID string skip assertEnrolledOperator entirely, falling through to bare verifyOperatorSignature (which only checks the sig against the caller-supplied pubkey). 0 passed, 1 failed.
vectors.description: F1 (SEVERE): Attack A on the engine grant path via the legacy operator_oid escape. updateGrantPredicate in src/agp/engine.ts gated assertEnrolledOperator behind a regex match on operator_oid format. An attacker with a fresh keypair and a non-OID operator_oid string (e.g. 'operator:steve') could update ANY named grant with no enrollment check. Fix: reject any operator_oid not in oid-<64hex> format with InvalidOperatorOidFormatError BEFORE the enrollment check. No legacy bypass on an authorization path.

fix.change: Removed regex-gated fallthrough. Added pre-check: if (!/^oid-[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.operator_oid)) throw new InvalidOperatorOidFormatError(...). assertEnrolledOperator is now UNCONDITIONAL on the authorization path.

defense_in_depth.change: Added OID-format check at the router edge before calling the engine. Non-OID operator_oid -> 400 { type: 'invalid_operator_oid_format' } before any engine processing.

observables: unenrolled attacker with non-OID operator_oid CANNOT update any grant

vectors.name: f1-grant-path-rejects-unenrolled-oid-format
vectors.failing_before: If an attacker used a valid oid-<64hex> format but was not enrolled, the enrollment check ran but the behavior depended on the prior regex gate being bypassed for non-OID strings. Post-fix this is now an unconditional check.
vectors.description: F1 companion: even a well-formed oid-<64hex> operator_oid must be enrolled. The enrollment check in updateGrantPredicate is now UNCONDITIONAL (ADR_015 Section 3.5). An OID-format but unenrolled operator gets InvalidOperatorSignatureError wrapping OperatorNotEnrolledError.
vectors.fix: Same as f1-grant-path-rejects-non-oid-operator: assertEnrolledOperator is now unconditional, not gated by the regex.
observables: updateGrantPredicate with valid OID format but unenrolled operator throws InvalidOperatorSignatureError

vectors.name: f2-prod-blocks-testclearenrollment
vectors.failing_before: NODE_ENV=production with SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS=true: _testClearEnrollment() executed without throwing. The only guard was SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS (no NODE_ENV check). A prod deploy with the env flag set could wipe the enrollment record.
vectors.description: F2 (MEDIUM): The test escape hatches were gated on SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS alone. Apply the same NODE_ENV=production hard-stop pattern as __setSigningBundleForTest in verify-router.ts:179. _testClearEnrollment() now throws when NODE_ENV==='production' BEFORE checking SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS.

fix.change: Added: if (process.env['NODE_ENV'] === 'production') { throw new Error('[operator-enrollment] _testClearEnrollment is TEST-ONLY...'); }

vectors.name: f2-prod-blocks-testenrolloperatorfortest
vectors.failing_before: NODE_ENV=production with SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS=true: _testEnrollOperatorForTest() executed without throwing, allowing test-key enrollment in a production process.

fix.change: Added: if (process.env['NODE_ENV'] === 'production') { throw new Error('[operator-enrollment] _testEnrollOperatorForTest is TEST-ONLY...'); }

vectors.name: f2-prod-blocks-capbundle-sentinel
vectors.failing_before: NODE_ENV=production with SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS=true: POST /local/gate with bundle_oid='capbundle/1' returned 201 (bypass active). The isTestMode check only looked at SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS, not NODE_ENV.
vectors.description: F2: The capbundle/1 sentinel grant-check bypass at src/agp/local-ingest-router.ts requires both SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS=true AND NODE_ENV!=='production'. A production deploy with the flag set must not reopen this bypass.
observables: POST /local/gate with bundle_oid='capbundle/1' under NODE_ENV=production returns 403, type='bundle_unknown'
SYNOI_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL_KEYS=true does NOT override the production block

vectors.name: f3-nonce-absent-from-pending-listing
vectors.failing_before: GET /local/pending returned challenge_nonce for every pending entry. Any loopback process that polled the listing could collect live nonces (nonce-farming). challenge_nonce was present in both POST /local/gate 201 response AND GET /local/pending listing.
vectors.description: F3 (MEDIUM): challenge_nonce is removed from the GET /local/pending listing. The client already received it in the POST /local/gate 201 response; it does not need to re-read it from the listing. Removing it from the listing closes the nonce-farming attack surface.

fix.change: Removed challenge_nonce from the .map() projection. Other fields (pending_oid, bundle_oid, principal_oid, panel_id, action_kind, originating_receipt_oid, ingested_at, status) are unchanged.

observables: GET /local/pending entries do NOT contain the key 'challenge_nonce'
pending entries still contain: pending_oid, bundle_oid, action_kind, status, ingested_at

vectors.name: f3-nonce-present-in-gate-response
vectors.description: F3 companion: POST /local/gate 201 response STILL returns challenge_nonce. The client flow is intact. The nonce is only removed from the polling endpoint, not from the single-issuance endpoint.

callers_migrated.change: Migrated from operator_oid='operator:steve' (legacy non-OID string) to enrolled oid-<64hex> operators via _testEnrollOperatorForTest. All 34 assertions pass. Added 2 new vectors: non-OID operator_oid throws InvalidOperatorOidFormatError (engine) and returns 400 type=invalid_operator_oid_format (HTTP). initTestSigningKeys() added to support enrollment DSSE signing. _testEnrollOperatorForTest updated to append to existing enrollment record (not replace) so multi-operator tests remain stable.

POST /v1/demo/session now calls enrollOperator(operator_pubkey_hex, 'demo-session') after the OID-binding check, so the demo operator is enrolled before updateGrantPredicate is called. 'already enrolled' error treated as success (idempotent per-session). demo-revoke.test.ts: 11 passed, 0 failed (was 4 failed before fix).

Same pattern as verify-router.ts __setSigningBundleForTest. PARTIAL-against-test-keys.
